3281dc4.summary: Sets up tutorial starting troops for player and enemy, spawning them and repositioning minions on the board.

3281e90.summary: Creates each starting troop for a side, hides card shadow and repositions all minions on that side of the board.

3281f54.summary: Instantiates a starting troop card for a side, sets it up as a unit in play, places it in a slot and adds it to unitsInPlay.

328102c.summary: Assigns the next unit-in-play order counter to a card, increments the counter and registers the card as in play.

3282148.summary: Selects a minion manager or global vars based on card type and side to get the unit size on board.

3281448.summary: Sets starting mana, psychic, plasma and spirit stone values for a side from the hero data and updates the mana UI holders.

32822b4.summary: Returns the starting mana for a side depending on whether the player goes first.

328230c.summary: Shows the tutorial pointer animation or tip for the current scripted action, positioning it by action type.

32815cc.summary: Creates the warlord starting troops in play for a side and repositions that side minions on the board.

3282720.summary: Returns the localized warcry text for a side from its selected cosmetic item or the default.

3282904.summary: Returns the cardback sprites for a side from its selected cardback cosmetic, or an empty pair.

3282ac8.summary: Unloads the cardback asset references of both player and enemy cosmetic items.

3281bac.summary: Instantiates the full hero (daimyo) card for a side, registers it in unitsInPlay and sets up the player manager.

3282e1c.summary: Loads and returns the card animation for a trait effect given trait, trigger and army, using addressables.

3282e30.summary: Preloads the animation assets of every trait effect for a trait and army.

3282fdc.summary: Releases addressable assets, removes voice line listeners and clears the BattleManager instance on destroy.

32831c8.summary: Handles finishing leaving a battle: either sets post-battle UI state or loads main menu or starts a tutorial match.

3283564.summary: Receives the enemy mulligan choices and environment card, stores them, confirms receipt and hides the mulligan wait text.

3283690.summary: Marks the mulligan ack as received and logs whether the enemy mulligan was received.

3283754.summary: Converts a BattleAction into a PlayerAction for network sending, filling type, ids, position, counter and timestamp.

32839e0.summary: Converts a received PlayerAction into a BattleAction for the local game, resolving cards by id and positions.

3284884.summary: Logs a battle action in the proper action list and, in networked games, sends it to the opponent via a Photon RPC.

3284ac8.summary: Records a received player action in the enemy action log and queues a remote action for execution.

3284b9c.summary: Builds a remote-action BattleAction from a PlayerAction and queues it as an auto action.

3284ea0.summary: Handles a disconnect during battle depending on battle stage, showing the disconnection popup or waiting for last actions.

32851d0.summary: Returns true if the opponent claims the match finished or actions are still queued.

3285344.summary: Stops the opponent last-actions coroutine and the forfeit-disconnected-enemy coroutine.

3285104.summary: Updates connection status for a disconnect and restarts the reconnect or forfeit coroutine, pausing the clock for the enemy.

3285430.summary: Handles failure to reconnect: resigns the player, marks disconnection or cancels a not-yet-started match.

3285908.summary: Handles a successful reconnection: restores connected status, unpauses clock, resends mulligan or lost actions.

3285a88.summary: Sends the player mulligan and environment card to the opponent via RPC; the rest is inlined Photon RPC and collection code.
